{{Infobox|title=Large bricks|invimage=Granite Slab|type=Resource pack feature}}
'''Large bricks''' is the look the resource pack gives to some doubled stone slabs. When two slabs of certain stones are stacked into a full block, Matcha Flavoured shows the block as a wall of large rectangular bricks cut from that stone, instead of the plain stone texture. A double slab otherwise behaves like the full block, so this gives builders brick versions of stones that have no bricks in vanilla ''Minecraft''.

== Behavior ==
The change is purely visual: the double slab is the vanilla <code>type=double</code> state of the slab, drops two slabs when broken and can be crafted back into the full block as usual.

{| class="wikitable"
! Double slab !! Appearance
|-
| Polished diorite slab || Large polished diorite bricks
|-
| Granite slab || Large granite bricks
|-
| Polished granite slab || Large polished granite bricks
|-
| Brick slab || Large clay bricks
|-
| Smooth red sandstone slab || A polished smooth red sandstone panel
|}

{{Upcoming|type=section}}
The repository's <code>main</code> branch adds large-brick textures for five more double slabs, which are not in [[Matcha Flavoured 1.12.2|1.12.2-beta]]:<ref>{{Source|MF_resourcepack/assets/minecraft/models/block/andesite_slab_double.json|at=5bf7c3e22adaabf2416c83b709842cb9a053cb95}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_resourcepack/assets/minecraft/blockstates/andesite_slab.json|at=5bf7c3e22adaabf2416c83b709842cb9a053cb95}}</ref>
